task.title: Promote Massive/Polygon to primary US market data and tighten IBKR boundary
task.summary_zh: 補齊 IBKR 更完整 market-data boundary，並把 Massive/Polygon 提升為美股主資料源。
acceptance: IBKR market-data boundary is explicitly limited and documented
Massive/Polygon becomes the governed primary US market-data path
US execution and research paths reference the same canonical symbol and dataset boundaries
task.next: Finalized after review approval: Massive / Polygon is the canonical primary US research-grade market-data path, IBKR market data is restricted to broker_execution execution-sync fallback, and focused IBKR adapter plus data-plane schema tests re-ran cleanly.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：DATA_SOURCE_SCOPE_MATRIX、US reference helpers 與 IBKR adapter 對齊到同一個邊界語義；Massive / Polygon 已被明確標成 US primary research-grade 路徑，IBKR market data 只保留 broker_execution / execution-sync fallback 身分。
Focused tests 重新實跑通過：services.execution.test_ibkr_adapter 6 tests、services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas 44 tests；未發現會阻擋 owner 收尾的回歸。

handoffs.message: Ready for review. Updated DATA_SOURCE_SCOPE_MATRIX to make Massive/Polygon the primary US research-grade source and constrain IBKR market data to broker_execution fallback only. Code changes are in services/data-plane/us_equity_reference.py and services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py with focused tests passing: python3 -m unittest services.execution.test_ibkr_adapter -v and python3 -m unittest services.data-plane.tests.test_data_plane_schemas -v.

Review approved. Massive / Polygon is now consistently marked as the primary US research-grade path, and IBKR market data is constrained to broker_execution execution-sync fallback only. Focused tests re-ran cleanly; owner can finalize this task to done.
